stories.title: Googlebook review: Google’s new laptops are woefully underbaked
stories.summary: Google’s new Googlebook laptops combine ChromeOS and Android in an effort to compete with Windows PCs and Apple’s MacBook Air. The review praises the hardware and Android-phone integration but says software flaws leave the expensive machines woefully underdeveloped.

links.headline: Googlebook review: Google’s new laptops are woefully underbaked
links.excerpt: Great hardware let down by software flaws on these pricey machines that combine ChromeOS with Android Google’s attempt to create a new type of laptop to compete with Windows and macOS machines is finally here, combining the best of ChromeOS and Android into the new Googlebook. stories.title: Beijing Signals Readiness to Talk to Trump's Team, Even Old Foes
stories.summary: China signalled that it is ready to engage with the Trump administration, including officials who have previously criticised Beijing. The Chinese foreign minister spoke by phone with new US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, a longstanding critic of China.

stories.title: Trump Says Colombia Will Accept Deportees, Ending Tariff Standoff
stories.summary: President Donald Trump said Colombia agreed to accept deportees, ending a tariff standoff between the two countries. The development came as Trump made immigration an early priority of his second term and US Immigration and Customs Enforcement reported more than 900 arrests on Sunday.
